headline: US financial crimes bureau discloses ‘cybersecurity incident’
summary: FinCEN, part of the Treasury Department, is investigating a cybersecurity incident. The incident involved unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems. No details on the scope or source have been released yet.

headline: The Verge’s 2026 gift guide for dads
summary: Forget traditional gifts like ties or shaving kits for dads. Dads deserve memorable and special presents. The Verge has curated a guide to help find the perfect gift.

headline: Why the US Army is about to blow up nearly 10,000 pounds of unstable explosives in Iowa
summary: The US Army plans to detonate 10,000 pounds of lead azide in Iowa. The detonation is scheduled for Wednesday at 9:00 AM CST at an ammunition plant. Experts were consulted to understand the implications of this event.

headline: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets
summary: Huawei has been found guilty of stealing US trade secrets by a jury. The verdict concludes a multi-year legal battle in New York. Accusations involved stealing source code and tech from T-Mobile, Cisco, and others.

headline: GTA 6 Analysis Shows PS5 Version Suffers 'Substantially' More Frequent Frame Rate Drops Than Xbox Series X Version
summary: Digital Foundry's analysis reveals GTA 6 performs better on Xbox Series X. The PS5 version experiences "substantially" more frequent frame rate drops. This sparks debate regarding Sony's "Plays Best on PS5" marketing claim.

headline: Yes, There Was One Thing Cut from GTA 6 for Australia, NZ
summary: Rockstar removed a temporary stat buff from GTA 6 for Australia and New Zealand. The cut content is unlikely to be noticed by players in those regions. It's a minor change specific to the Australian/NZ release.

headline: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 Finale Recap and Review
summary: The Rings of Power Season 3 finale offered exciting fan moments. The final two episodes focused more on setup than payoff. The review highlights a lack of resolution despite engaging elements.

headline: Hisense 55-Inch 4K ULED TV Gets a GTA 6-Ready Black Friday Discount at Amazon
summary: Amazon is offering a Black Friday discount on a 55-inch Hisense 4K ULED TV. The TV features a 165Hz display and anti-glare screen. It's marketed as ideal for playing GTA 6.

headline: Energy bills to rise by 26% from January after gas prices surge
summary: Energy bills are projected to increase by 26% starting January. This surge is due to rising gas prices. A typical household could see annual bills jump from £1,723 to £2,166.

headline: 'I only use the washing machine on a Sunday' - how we're keeping our energy bills down
summary: The BBC spoke with individuals implementing strategies to reduce energy bills. Tips include specific days for appliance use, like washing on Sundays. The article highlights practical steps people take to manage costs.

headline: Two men charged with trespass at Prince and Princess of Wales's Norfolk home
summary: Two men have been charged with trespass at Sandringham Estate. The charges follow reports of suspicious activity at the royal home. The Norfolk home belongs to the Prince and Princess of Wales.

headline: Third of young Brits have never had sex, but many are sexting and watching porn
summary: A significant portion of young people in Britain report never having had sex. Despite this, many are engaging in sexting. Watching porn is also a common activity among this demographic.
